name: mcp-oauth
description: MCP OAuth 2.1 authorization server for mcp.diegonmarcos.com (option 31.1, approved 2026-10-28): RFC 8414/9728 discovery, RFC 7591 DCR, /authorize behind Authelia, PKCE S256 /token, opaque tokens introspected by introspect-proxy
_status: approved/live: owner approved option 31.1 on 2026-10-28; runtime needs dist/.secrets (INTROSPECT_SECRET, FORM_SECRET) provisioned on gcp-proxy via secrets.yaml. HOST RETARGET (#1252 vs #1104, 2026-10-30): the mcp.diegonmarcos.com host is deleted by #1104, so caddy_config.mcp_oauth (host mcp.diegonmarcos.com) must NOT be derived into build-caddy*.json as is. Decision: container, image and secrets work stay; the AS front door moves to the surviving tiers (open discovery/register/token on the c3-pub allowlist under /mcp-oauth/, /authorize and the MCP tool endpoints on c3-pvt behind the session-or-bearer gate, protected-resource metadata referenced from the 401 WWW-Authenticate). Do not derive or ship the Caddy block until that retarget lands and the owner confirms it against owner decision 31 (fleet MCP clients use bearer, never OAuth; the AS serves only claude.ai-style connectors).
_ship_skip: parked (#1252): deploy.host local keeps Ship from building/deploying this service (same marker as infra-cloud_gcloud and infra-bld_cloud-builder-x; build-gha.json then omits it). Restore host gcp-proxy and remote_path /opt/containers/mcp-oauth together with provisioning dist/.secrets (INTROSPECT_SECRET, FORM_SECRET) on gcp-proxy.

unit.cmd: python3 -m pip install -q flask==3.0.0 'PyJWT[crypto]==2.9.0' pytest && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test

api.description: OAuth 2.1 AS for MCP connectors (claude.ai, claude.com, localhost). Public paths are exactly the mcp.diegonmarcos.com entry of caddy_config.edge_auth.public_open; /introspect is mesh-only.
